title: Raise First Journey character UI and generated-character quality to supplied reference bar
prompt: Treat the user's four supplied First Journey / Judy reference boards as a STRICT visual-quality contract, not loose inspiration. This task follows the PHOTO->CHARACTER blocker and must improve the implementation/validation harness so a candidate cannot pass merely because the UI renders or an image exists. Required quality bar: polished premium child-friendly Ready & Set mobile UI; coherent pale sky-blue world; strong navy/blue typography hierarchy; rounded white cards; deliberate spacing; large clean touch targets; consistent mascot/speech-bubble support; high-quality 3D animated-film-like child explorer character; facial resemblance to reference photo where permitted by generation system; stable hairstyle/face/outfit identity across candidate/confirm/complete and visual-ID views; coherent explorer outfit/accessories; candidate variants that are meaningfully different but visibly the same child identity; final selected character suitable for front/side/back, expressions and action reuse. Add or strengthen a machine-checkable Visual Fidelity Gate with separate gates for REFERENCE_COVERAGE, UI_LAYOUT, CHARACTER_IDENTITY, CHARACTER_RENDER_QUALITY, CROSS_VIEW_CONSISTENCY, MOBILE_RESPONSIVE, and SIDE_BY_SIDE_REVIEW. Explicitly reject placeholder art, emoji/icon substitutes, flat low-detail cartoons, distorted anatomy/hands/eyes, inconsistent face/hair/outfit between screens, low-resolution/cropped outputs, generic unrelated child characters, weak resemblance, and layouts materially drifting from the supplied references. Preserve PHOTO -> CHARACTER -> 3 candidates -> CONFIRM -> COMPLETE flow. Do not claim visual PASS from static markers alone; document what remains runtime/image-output-only. Do not call paid image generation and do not spend credits. Keep paid generation approval-gated. Work only on Ready isolated work branch; no main/prod merge, deployment, release, location tracking, or moving Snap & Pop growth/badges/Wish Shop into Ready. Run bounded syntax/static/regression checks and report changed files, checks, visual gates that are automated, and gates requiring actual rendered screenshots/generated outputs.
